rows.en: (My packed lunch today was onigiri, right?)

\p, having lunch?
That's something unusual you're eating.

Oh, Hilda-sensei.
This? It's called an "onigiri." It's rice
pressed together into a nice, firm shape.

Oh, is that so?
It looks... yes, like that thing called "sushi."

I guess so.
But unlike "sushi," there's a filling inside,
so there's a little thrill to it.
I see. Interesting.
Would you like one too, Sensei?
Then I'll take one...

It's nicely salted. Quite tasty.
And the filling... the filling... this is...

Oh, that's an "umeboshi," a pickled plum.
It's sour, so it goes perfectly with rice.
rows.notes: 'a pickled plum' added as a gloss: the player is explaining Japanese food to Hilda.

rows.en:
Ugh... I-I see...
Oh?! Right, I just remembered something I have to do!

I'll gratefully take this with me.
S-see you...
H-huh? Hilda-sensei?

(Could it be that Hilda-sensei
can't stand umeboshi...?)
(My packed lunch today was onigiri, wasn't it?)

Oh, that's an "umeboshi," a pickled plum.
It's sour, so it goes perfectly with rice, right?

(Next is Hilda-sensei's class.
If I'm late, I'm in trouble!)
S-sorry! Hilda...-sensei...?

Honestly, what do you think you're doing?!
What if somebody got hurt over something like this?!
rows.notes: Who would get hurt is unstated (you / me); kept impersonal with 'somebody'.

rows.en:
Sorry...
...Was that scream just now... yours, Hilda-sensei?
It sounded awfully cute...

What are you babbling about?! Get going!
If you're late, I'll have you running laps all class!
Y-yes! Excuse me!

(When she's caught off guard, Sensei makes
a surprisingly cute sound...)

(Next is Hilda-sensei's class.
I can't be late!)
Eek!
rows.notes: Female-only no-name-plate yelp, x4 (also nml_nns_007, nml_she_007, nml_yuu_008, all female collisions): read as the player's yelp. 'Eek!' also works if it is Hilda's scream.

rows.en:
Sorry...
...Was that scream just now... yours, Hilda-sensei?
Your voice sounded kind of different from usual...
Y-yes! I'm sorry!
(All right, lunch break! What should I eat...)
(Huh? Is Hilda-sensei having lunch?)
Hilda-sensei, are you about to have lunch?

Yes, that's right.
The weather's nice, so I thought I'd eat outside.

Is that so?
Huh? But what are you going to eat?
All I can see is a thermos...
rows.notes: 'potto' read as a food thermos (the pot-au-feu is inside it).

rows.en:
Hm? Oh, I brought it in here.
See?
(Wow, that smells great! Is that pot-au-feu...?)

I ended up making too much last night,
so I figured I might as well bring it for lunch.
Well? Do you want some too?
Then I'll gladly take you up on that!
Mm. There's plenty, so don't hold back.
(Hilda-sensei's cooking was delicious!)
(Okay, lunch break! What should I eat~...)
(Hm? Is Hilda-sensei having lunch?)

Oh, really?
Huh...? But what are you going to eat?
All I can see is a thermos...
(Wow, that smells great! That's pot-au-feu, right...?)
Then I'll gladly take you up on that~!
(Hilda-sensei's cooking was delicious!)
(Okay, EX-Gear training's over. Next class is...)
Hey, \p!
Yes?! Hilda-sensei?
Were you taking that class seriously just now?

Yes, of course!
It'd be harder to slack off while flying through the air!

I see. I suppose so...
In that case, you should build more strength in your core.
Huh? Uh...?

Since you lack the strength, your posture
in the air was strained, and you were wobbling a bit.
Huh, was I?

Yes. Build a bit more strength, and you should be
able to fly with ease. Keep that in mind for a while.

(Hilda-sensei really keeps an eye on us,
even in classes that aren't hers.)

Yes, of course!
It's way harder to slack off while flying, anyway!
Huh? Sorry?

(Hilda-sensei really keeps an eye on us,
even in classes that aren't hers~)

(Okay, that's the end of another week...
What should I do this weekend...)

(Oh, it's Hilda-sensei...
Maybe I'll ask about her weekend plans for ideas.)
Hilda-sensei, do you have a moment?

Hm? \p?
What is it?

Well, I thought I'd ask about your weekend plans,
Sensei, and get some ideas...
Hm, I see. I doubt they'll be much help, though...

Huh, really?
But I'd still like to hear them, if you don't mind...

Ah, I see. Well...
This weekend, I was planning to do some cooking...

I see!
...But the whole weekend?

Yes, that's right.
I'm going to try my hand at a curry
with my own original spice blend.
Original... spice blend... huh...

Maybe you should find a hobby and give it a try too.
Well, get home safe.
(Hilda-sensei's cooking is the real deal, huh...)

(Okay, that's the end of another week.
What should I do this weekend~...)

(Oh, Hilda-sensei...
I'll ask about her weekend plans for some ideas.)

Um, I was thinking I'd ask about your weekend plans,
Sensei, for some ideas...

Huh, really?
But I'd still like to hear them, if that's okay...

Wow!
...But the whole weekend?
(Hilda-sensei's cooking is the real deal...)
